samples.question: The image is split into four quadrants (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right) by two light-grey lines that cross at the image centre, where a small mid-grey diamond marker is drawn. Each quadrant contains one dark filled dot. Exactly one dot is closer to the central marker than every other dot. Which quadrant contains the dot that is nearest to the central marker? Answer with one quadrant name.
